changelog:
• Custom App Icons: Choose between Emerald, Dark Minimalist, Gold Luxury, Neon Cyberpunk, or Crimson Passion.
• Bitrate & Audio Badge: High-fidelity audio quality badge now active by default across mini-player and full-screen player.
• Audio Focus Management: Smooth audio ducking and auto-pause when incoming calls, navigation, or other apps play audio.
• Bluetooth Auto-Resume: Automatically resume playback when reconnecting to car audio or Bluetooth headphones.
• Network Stall Protection: Option to auto-skip unplayable songs on slow/interrupted network connections.
• Clean Spotify-style Playlist Management: Cleaner tracklist layout with dedicated reorder/edit mode.
• Anonymous Feedback & Diagnostics: Send bug reports or suggestions with optional screenshots directly from Settings.
